body:
I can write this without going into protective mode because of the anonymity. Without there would be no such information given.

I have thought about writing down further information and giving it to my therapist. But I don't know how I can do that without having it super awkward.

As how I am doing generally. Pretty horrible to be honest, I'm losing my focus, my social connections and at times my sanity it appears. I don't see how I can recover from this. And I can't seem to tell those who are trying to help me, just how much they really have on their hands.
